Q: agent library failed to init: instrument A:

It seems that it's a project dependant bug, because in the same workspace, I have the issue with one project not with another one.

Delete the project and .project .settings .classpath .factorypath, then re-import your project.

Also check things like byte-buddy loader.

Q: PDF Digital Signature Removal best practice A:

As an aside, I just took a look at your example PDF. In it neither a signature nor a signature field has been removed at all: Both signature fields are still in the AcroForm fields array and also still are signed, merely the widget annotation of one of them has been removed from a page.

Thus, the associated signature is still there and still signs the document. Merely the role/function of the signature implied by the position of the signature visualization on the page is lost.

Q: Where to put linkTo method in Spring? A:

Dev-B is correct because centralizing all link-building logic, including "self" links, in a dedicated Assembler class adheres strictly to the Single Responsibility Principle and promotes a cleaner architecture. If a Controller manages its own "self" links while the Assembler handles related links, the resource's representation logic becomes fragmented across multiple layers, making the codebase harder to maintain and test. Furthermore, placing all routing and link logic in the Assembler ensures maximum reusability. If multiple controllers need to return the same resource type, they can all rely on the single Assembler to consistently attach the complete set of hypermedia links without duplicating code.

Q: Is it undefined behavior to store any value other than zero or one in a `bool` in C++? A:

The common (practically universal) convention is that 0x0 is false and any other value is true. That is 'if any bit set, true'. Treating 0x0 as true will not work on any normal implementation.
